    • uploadStudentsCsv

      @PreAuthorize("hasRole('ROLE_ADMIN')") @PostMapping(value="/upload/csv", consumes="multipart/form-data") public CsvUploadResult uploadStudentsCsv(@RequestParam Long courseId, @RequestParam("file") org.springframework.web.multipart.MultipartFile file) throws IOException
      Bulk-adds roster students to a course from an uploaded CSV file. The CSV's header row is used to auto-detect which school's roster export format it is (see StudentCsvFormat); rows whose email is already on the course roster are skipped rather than duplicated.
      Parameters:
      courseId - the course to add the students to
      file - the uploaded CSV file
      Returns:
      a summary of how many students were created, and which emails were skipped as already-on-roster
      Throws:
      IOException
